newsitem.title: USA: FBI hunts for rental truck in suspected bomb plot.
newsitem.headline: FBI hunts for rental truck in suspected bomb plot.

text.p: The FBI has launched a nationwide search for a rental truck that may be carrying large amounts of fertiliser and diesel fuel for possible use in a terrorist bomb attack, police said on Monday.

Police in the small town of Haltom City near Dallas said they were told that three white men filled up large containers of diesel fuel and loaded it onto the truck at a gasoline station last Saturday. The truck was rented from U-Haul.
The truck had left by the time police arrived, prompting the FBI and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms to cast a nationwide dragnet for the three men and the truck.

"Obviously, the concern is that this could be another Oklahoma City," said Detective Sgt. Tony Veltre, referring to the bomb explosion that destroyed a federal government building in April, 1995, killing 168 people.

The FBI said in a statement that it had put out a nationwide terrorist threat advisory and that the truck may be carrying 4,500 pounds (2,041 kilogram) of ammonium nitrate fertiliser and 30 gallons (113.6 litres) of diesel fuel.
The orange and white U-Haul truck is about 15 feet (4 metres) long and has the words "11,000 pound capacity" written on the side.
Police said they were first alerted by a 911 call from a resident who said he saw three men load the diesel fuel into the back of a rental truck already filled with bags of fertiliser.
Veltre said there was no reliable information on the quantity of ammonium nitrate, the chemical agent in fertilisers, which was allegedly inside the truck.
"We cannot confirm that information, but we want to find that truck as soon as possible," Veltre said. "We would view as very serious any mixture of fertiliser and fuel oil."

At the Justice Department in Washington, Deputy Attorney General Jamie Gorelick confirmed that an alert had been issued for the truck. She said the information came from a source who may or may not be reliable, but that the step had been taken as a precaution.

Prosecutors in the Oklahoma City blast say chief suspect Timothy McVeigh used ammonium nitrate and fuel to make the bomb and loaded it onto a Ryder truck that blew up outside the Alfred P. Murrah federal building.
